_comment: Wave 8E Phase 6 DEFAULT themes + the production Diwali Festive Sale campaign (2026-09-04: promoted from the original placeholder test campaign to real seasonal copy, paired with the 'Diwali Festive Sale — 20% Off' AUTOMATIC promotion created by seed-sale-diwali-campaigns.js). seed-content-campaigns.js backfills content_themes / content_campaigns and publishes v1+ of each (idempotent, §115) — this file is the CANONICAL source for the Diwali campaign; edit it here, not ad hoc, or a re-seed will revert the change.
